_source: or/REPORT.md Response Schema + verified sample markup (or/samples/paging_20261026T192128Z/A_multi_loc_008_019.body: 654+373 rows; or/samples/detail_20261026T192030Z/02_detail_4594067.body: 16 labels; or/samples/bootstrap_20261026T191507Z_explore/adv.body: vocabs)
stable_id: ord int — td:nth-child(1) text == jobdisplay href ord param == Job Listing ID value (all equal; e.g. 4594067)
listing_table: table#tbl_jobSearch tbody tr (query rows, ord-ascending) + table#tbl_jobSearch2 tbody tr (statewide block, same columns, dedupe by ord)
listing_headings: thead th: Job ID, Job Title, Location, Posted, Salary, Hours, Experience, Types (data-field: ID, JOB_TITLE, ADDRESS_CITY, lmod_yyyymmdd, SALARY_MIN_STARTING_AMT, HOURS_PER_WEEK_NBR, EXPCD_DESCR)

listing_columns.wage: td:nth-child(5) free text e.g. '$30.00 to $36.00 / Hr'
listing_columns.experience: td:nth-child(7) free text e.g. 'At least 6 years', 'None'
listing_columns.types: td:nth-child(8) .badge codes csv e.g. 'SR' (Self-referral), 'LD' (Limited Duration), 'NL' (National Labor)

statewide_block: table#tbl_jobSearch2 preceded by span#theLabel2 'There are currently 373 statewide recruitments, included in all search results as required by USDOL Regulations.' — identical 373 ords on every page, disjoint from query set; carry once
truncation_banner: Text 'Reached limit: 1000 of {N} Jobs matching {criteria}' (e.g. '1000 of 26699', '1000 of 5182 Jobs matching Keyword: SALES') — presence means capped, split the partition, discard the page
total_form: Reached limit banner total N (26,699 via all-54-loc query 2026-10-26); uncapped pages carry NO total — count rows instead
detail_title: <title>Jobs Listed with WorkSource Oregon</title> (same on list and detail pages — not a discriminator)
detail_header_pairs: label div.col-*-auto.text-md-end.fw-bold + value in NEXT SIBLING div (Job Listing ID, Job Title)
detail_body_pairs: label span.fw-bold.me-1 + value in next sibling span.text_jobdetail (Application Deadline, Job Location, Date Posted, Hours Worked Per Week, Shift, Duration of Job, Benefits Offered, Additional Benefits, Experience Required, Education Required, Minimum Age, Employer Will Perform)
detail_sections: heading div.fw-bold.mb-2 + content in NEXT SIBLING div (Job Summary = description; Compensation incl. Benefits Offered; SOC occupation title div has no stable label)
detail_html_no_json: detail is server-rendered HTML only; no JSON representation exists site-wide (or/samples/bootstrap_20261026T191507Z/netlog.jsonl: 0 JSON)
contact_placeholder_anonymous: Between _format_self_refer_instr markers: 'You may contact this employer directly.' + button[onclick*=selfrefer/index.cfm?ord=] 'Obtain Contact Information' — crawler treats as absent, never follows
contact_block: PROHIBITED — employer name/contact/How-to-Apply render only after the self-referral write; selectors documented ONLY in reconnaissance/OR/README.md prohibition-evidence section, never here, never in code
apply_link: NONE — no apply <a href> element exists anywhere; How-to-Apply is free text (post-write only)
vocab_location: adv form select#location1 (name=loc): 62 OPTIONs, 54 distinct 3-digit codes; single (008=Albany) or regional csv values (Central Oregon='011,012,020,023,024,043,044,048'); loc2/loc3 single-code slots
vocab_occupation: adv form select#occupationalGroup (name=cat): 36 options, 00=Any + 35 groups (34=Architecture and Engineering …); cat alone is valid criteria except 00
vocab_date: adv form select#datePosted (name=since): YYYYMMDD values (Today, Last 24 hours, …) — [uncertain: never exercised, semantics unconfirmed]
no_export_feed: Zero .xml/.rss/.csv/format=xml refs and no download link across all captures — no official feed

body_kind_signals.app: 15-30 KB+ with Jobs Listed with WorkSource Oregon + tbl_jobSearch
body_kind_signals.waf_block: 1,581 B plain text starting 'Please advise your users'
